newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand hits all-time low against dollar.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand hits all-time low against dollar.

text.p: The South African rand on Friday broke through its lowest level of 4.59 bid against the dollar touched in after-hours trade on August 19.
The currency was at 4.5930/80 at 1105 GMT.
Foreign exchange dealers said the rand was hit by heavy selling out of London and a weak bond market, depressed by comments from central bank governor Chris Stals at a conference in Johannesburg.

Stals warned that already high South African interest rates might have to be raised further if there was no slowdown in money supply growth, and cautioned the country's low reserves ruled out any early scrapping of exchange controls on residents.
South African banks' prime lending rate currently stands at 19.25 percent.
